SELECT DISTINCT concat(BUG.BUGID,'__b') problemid, BUG.BUGNUMBER code,o.orgname company,'缺陷' source,BUG.DISCOVERPERSON discoverer,bug.BUGDESCRIPTE details FROM TBL_NBSJ_BUG bug LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION o ON o.orgid = BUG.BUGDEPARTMENT
BUG.NEEDREFORM = '是' AND BUG.INBUGIDB IS NULL and BUG.BUGBYSYSTEM like '%nb%'
AND BUG.BUGID NOT IN (#{selectidIdsstr})
and BUG.BUGNUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{re.code}),'%')
and BUG.PROJECTID = #{projectid}
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT concat(QU.QUESTIONID,'__p') problemid, AA.SHEETCODE code,aa.orgIdNames company,'审计发现' source, AA.REALNAME discoverer,substr(aa.AUDITDISCOVERABLE,400,1) details FROM TBL_NBSJ_QUESTION qu LEFT JOIN (SELECT SH.SHEETID, SA.REALNAME, SH.PROJECTID, SH.SHEETCODE, SH.CREATESTAFF, ORG.ORGNAME,SH.AUDITDISCOVERABLE,sh.orgIdNames FROM TBL_NBSJ_SHEET sh LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF sa ON SH.CREATESTAFF = SA.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION org ON sh.AUDITORG = ORG.ORGID) aa ON QU.SHEETID = AA.SHEETID WHERE 1 = 1 AND QU.RECSTATUS = 1 AND AA.PROJECTID = #{projectid}
AND QU.QUESTIONID NOT IN (#{selectidIdsstr})
and SHEETCODE like concat(concat('%',#{re.code}),'%')
ORDER BY problemid

select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT concat(BUG.BUGID,'__b') problemid,BUG.BUGNUMBER code,o.orgname company,'缺陷' source,BUG.DISCOVERPERSON discoverer,sa.REALNAME zgzxxrname,bug.BUGDESCRIPTE details,RE.STATUS STATUS,re.REFORMID REFORMID,re.zgjgresult, re.WXHSTATUS,pro.PRJOECTNAME,pro.AUDITORGID,re.SOLUTIONID FROM TBL_NBSJ_BUG bug LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT pro on BUG.PROJECTID=PRO.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_REFOPM re ON BUG.BUGID = RE.BUGID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION o ON o.orgid = BUG.BUGDEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF sa ON re.PERONINCHARGE = SA.STAFFID
BUG.NEEDREFORM = '是' AND BUG.INBUGIDB IS NULL AND ( (re.STATUS =3 and re.LASTREFORMSTATUS =1 AND re.reformresult is not null and re.zgjgresult != '已完成整改' ) or ( re.WXHSTATUS=1 and re.LASTREFORMSTATUS =1 ) )
and BUG.BUGNUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{re.code}),'%')
and pro.PRJOECTNAME like concat(concat('%',#{re.projectname}),'%')
and pro.AUDITORGID = #{re.company}
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT concat(QU.QUESTIONID,'__p') problemid, AA.SHEETCODE code,aa.orgname company,'审计发现' source,AA.REALNAME discoverer,bb.REALNAME zgzxxrname,substr(aa.AUDITDISCOVERABLE,400,1) details,bb.STATUS STATUS,bb.REFORMID,bb.zgjgresult,bb.WXHSTATUS,aa.PRJOECTNAME,aa.AUDITORGID,bb.SOLUTIONID FROM TBL_NBSJ_QUESTION qu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SH.SHEETID,SA.REALNAME,SH.PROJECTID,SH.SHEETCODE,SH.CREATESTAFF,ORG.ORGNAME,SH.AUDITDISCOVERABLE,SH.ORGIDNAMES FROM TBL_NBSJ_SHEET sh FROM TBL_NBSJ_QUESTION qu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SH.SHEETID,SA.REALNAME,SH.PROJECTID,SH.SHEETCODE,SH.CREATESTAFF,ORG.ORGNAME,SH.AUDITDISCOVERABLE,PRO.PRJOECTNAME,PRO.AUDITORGID FROM TBL_NBSJ_SHEET sh LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT pro on SH.PROJECTID=PRO.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RE.QUESTIONID,SA.REALNAME,RE.STATUS,RE.LASTREFORMSTATUS,RE.SOLUTIONID,re.REFORMID,re.PERONINCHARGE,RE.REFORMRESULT,RE.REFORMMEASURE,RE.REFORMCARRYOUT FROM TBL_NBSJ_REFOPM re LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF sa ON re.PERONINCHARGE = SA.STAFFID ) bb ON BB.QUESTIONID = QU.QUESTIONID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF sa ON SH.CREATESTAFF = SA.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION org ON sh.AUDITORG = ORG.ORGID ) aa ON QU.SHEETID = AA.SHEETID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RE.QUESTIONID,SA.REALNAME,RE.STATUS,RE.LASTREFORMSTATUS,RE.SOLUTIONID,re.REFORMID,re.PERONINCHARGE,re.zgjgresult,re.WXHSTATUS FROM TBL_NBSJ_REFOPM re LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF sa ON re.PERONINCHARGE = SA.STAFFID ) bb ON BB.QUESTIONID = QU.QUESTIONID WHERE 1 = 1 AND QU.RECSTATUS = 1 and bb.SOLUTIONID= #{solutionid} WHERE 1 = 1 AND QU.RECSTATUS = 1 AND ((QU.RECSTATUS = 1 AND bb.STATUS =3 and bb.LASTREFORMSTATUS =1 AND bb.zgjgresult is not null and bb.zgjgresult <> '已完成整改' ) or ( QU.RECSTATUS = 1 AND bb.WXHSTATUS=1 and bb.LASTREFORMSTATUS =1 ) )
and SHEETCODE like concat(concat('%',#{re.code}),'%')
and PRJOECTNAME like concat(concat('%',#{re.projectname}),'%')
and AUDITORGID = #{re.company}
ORDER BY problemid

SELECT RE.REFORMID,PRO.PRJOECTNAME,CASE WHEN SH.ORGIDS=NULL THEN ST.REALNAME ELSE SH.ORGIDNAMES END oegname,SH.SHEETCODE,substr(sh.AUDITDISCOVERABLE,400,1) auditDiscoverable,RE.REFORMRESULT,RE.REFORMMEASURE,STA.REALNAME,RE.STATUS from TBL_NBSJ_REFOPM re LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT pro on RE.PROJECTID=PRO.PROJECTID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF sta on RE.PERONINCHARGE=STA.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_QUESTION qu on re.QUESTIONID=QU.QUESTIONID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_SHEET sh on QU.SHEETID=SH.SHEETID LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF st on SH.AUDITSTAFFID=ST.STAFFID LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION org on SH.AUDITORG=ORG.ORGID
RE.LASTREFORMSTATUS=1 AND RE.PROJECTID is not NULL
and PRO.PRJOECTNAME like concat(concat('%',#{projectname}),'%')
and SHEETCODE like concat(concat('%',#{code}),'%')
and (sh.AUDITORG = #{auditorg} or sh.AUDITSTAFFID = #{auditorg} )
order BY REFORMID
